app.title: Show HN: Proton Drive for Linux
app.author: khaosdoctor
app.description: A FUSE filesystem implementation that mounts Proton Drive as a local directory on Linux, enabling transparent read/write access to Proton's cloud storage.
proposed_tests: Install the package via cargo or pre-built binaries
Run `proton-drive --help` and verify output contains expected flags
Mount the filesystem to a test directory using a temporary Proton account
Create a new file in the mounted directory, verify it appears in Proton Drive web UI
Delete a file via the filesystem and confirm removal in the cloud
